description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/cat-drop-table-in-relation: DROP TABLE Child returned no error yet Child, R_Child, R_CD and R_CU were all listed afterwards from cached collections. On a writable copy of r-def-cat-txn-rel-accdb: DROP TABLE Parent (primary side of three relations), then DROP TABLE Child (foreign side of R_Child), then DROP TABLE Parent again. After each statement DBEngine.Errors is read right before and right after, and the TableDefs, Relations and QueryDefs are listed after Refresh. Then the Database is closed and reopened read-only, the same three collections are listed and SELECT * FROM Child is run.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
